text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—'Singular devotion. All is for the sake of leading everyone
to the ideal world. "Strength" is the bare minimum
requisite condition for earning trust.'

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haaa~... President Rudolf
is just sooo, sooo cooool...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Smart, beautiful, and above all, ridiculously strong!
Everyone knows how incredible she is.
Nobody could ever claim she isn't strong.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—A cool person for whom running comes as naturally as breathing.
How could I ever become someone like that?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? 'Lately, I have been honing my sensibilities
by appreciating fine art.'
Oho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, upon visiting an art museum—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmmm~...?
Wh-What even is this painting? I don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—A profound realization. "Not understanding"...
That is precisely the most fitting attitude toward this altarpiece.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Eek!
P-President...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence, Tsuyoshi.
Were you interested in Western art as well?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! You see,
I read that special feature article about you the other day, President!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It said you enjoy art appreciation, so I thought maybe if I did the same thing, I could become cool like you, President...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see. Thank you.
Truly, you are pure and unadulterated.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Pure and un-adult...?
??

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still, paintings are so difficult.
So far, all I understand is the artist and what era they were painted in.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. In that case, shall I explain it to you?
...Consider it opened! The Rudolf Q&A Corner.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Is that really okay?!
Taking up your precious time, President...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I could never turn away someone who looks up to me. Though my knowledge may pale in comparison to a professional curator, if you wouldn't mind?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, I'm so happy!!
I'm in your care!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. First, regarding this piece.
It is the artist's masterpiece, rich with various allegories. What is depicted on the far right is—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Thank you so very much for today!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Your explanations were so thorough and easy to follow, President! I learned so much!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: To think you know this much about paintings too, you're truly incredible, President!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I merely spoke of what I enjoy. You listened with such pure earnestness that I found myself thoroughly enjoying it as well.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Anyone would listen earnestly if it's you speaking, President~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: By the way, are you heading straight back to the academy? If so, together...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I have an errand at the drugstore.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eh?! Are you feeling unwell somewhere?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No. It's just that student council duties have piled up lately. I thought I might pick up a nutritional supplement drink.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Not just lately, you always seem busy. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Um! If it's a nutritional drink... I can make one for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day, this time on the academy grounds—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —So, this is the 'Tsuyoshi Special Drink' you spoke of.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Pickled plums, lemons, cured mackerel...
I packed in lots of things that are fantastic for fatigue recovery!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Since I have a weak constitution, I've been researching health drinks for myself. This one comes especially recommended!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Though when I drink it myself, I prioritize effect over taste. I tried to make it delicious for you, President, but just in case—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Aah?! You're drinking it already?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Awa-wa! H-How is it...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Did you adjust it by adding extra honey? It is quite delicious. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Even so, to have crafted this drink entirely on your own. It has a complex depth of flavor... one can tell it contains a multitude of ingredients. Would you mind telling me the detailed recipe?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, gladly!!
